item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 14/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Wutip will make landfall again near Leizhou Peninsula today, then move across the vicinity of Guangdong-Guangxi boundary. Its associated rainbands will affect the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. There will be heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the region. It will be windy with swells. Wutip will depart from the coastal areas and weaken gradually early next week. However, under the influence of a southerly airstream and upper-air disturbances, there will still be occasional heavy showers and thunderstorms over Guangdong. An anticyclone aloft is expected to strengthen gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather over Guangdong will improve and it will be hot.

Wind: South to southeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore later, up to force 8 on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional squally showers and a few thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier in some areas at first. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
